tests.title: Common.Register adds a --preflight boolean flag defaulting to false with the documented usage string
given: a fresh flag.FlagSet and an empty Common
tests.when: Common.Register(fs) is called and fs is parsed with no arguments
then: Common.Preflight is false
fs.Lookup("preflight") is non-nil
its Usage string equals "run every check that would refuse the run, then stop; makes no change beyond a verification baseline"
tests.pseudocode: var c Common; fs := flag.NewFlagSet(...); c.Register(fs); fs.Parse(nil); assert c.Preflight == false; f := fs.Lookup("preflight"); assert f.Usage == "run every check that would refuse the run, then stop; makes no change beyond a verification baseline"

tests.title: --schema takes priority over --preflight and exits before the input is classified
given: an App with both --schema support and PreflightExec configured
tests.when: the tool is invoked with both --schema and --preflight
then: stdout carries only the self-description document
PreflightExec is not invoked
Exec is not invoked
the exit code is 0
tests.pseudocode: code := app.Main(ctx, []string{"--schema","--preflight","some input"}, ...); assert code == 0; assert !preflightExecCalled; assert !execCalled; assert isSelfDescription(stdout)

tests.title: Every other flag is parsed and honoured identically whether or not --preflight is set
given: a tool invoked twice on the same input and workspace: once plain, once with --preflight added
tests.when: App.execute runs PreCheck, Workspace resolution, Resolve, CheckInput and ResolveModel for both invocations
then: the PreCheck outcome is identical for both invocations
the CheckInput outcome is identical for both invocations
the resolved Workspace root is identical for both invocations
the resolved model id and thinking level are identical for both invocations
tests.pseudocode: a := runCapturingDeps(argv); b := runCapturingDeps(append(argv, "--preflight")); assert a.Workspace.Root == b.Workspace.Root; assert a.Model.Model.ID == b.Model.Model.ID

tests.title: fix --preflight --dry-run produces the byte-for-byte same envelope as fix --preflight alone
given: a clean git workspace with a resolvable model and no forge write needed
tests.when: fix is invoked once with --preflight --dry-run and once with only --preflight, on the same input and workspace state
then: the two JSON stdout payloads are byte-for-byte equal
tests.pseudocode: outA := runFix(dir, []string{"--preflight","--dry-run",input}); outB := runFix(dir2, []string{"--preflight",input}); assert bytes.Equal(outA, outB)

tests.title: toolio.App carries a PreflightExec field with the same signature shape as Exec
tests.when: an App value is constructed with a non-nil PreflightExec
then: App.PreflightExec is assignable and callable as func(context.Context, Deps) (int, any, *ErrorInfo)
tests.pseudocode: app := App{PreflightExec: func(ctx context.Context, d Deps) (int, any, *ErrorInfo) { return 0, nil, nil }}; code, _, _ := app.PreflightExec(ctx, Deps{}); assert code == 0

tests.title: App.execute dispatches to PreflightExec, not Exec, when --preflight is set, passing identical Deps
given: an App with both Exec and PreflightExec set, each recording the Deps it received
tests.when: the tool is invoked with --preflight against a resolvable input and model
then: PreflightExec is called exactly once
Exec is not called
the Deps.Workspace, Deps.Runner, Deps.Forge, Deps.Model and Deps.Input passed to PreflightExec equal what a parallel invocation without --preflight passes to Exec
tests.pseudocode: execDeps := captureExecDeps(argvNoPreflight); pfDeps := capturePreflightDeps(argvWithPreflight); assert pfDeps.Workspace.Root == execDeps.Workspace.Root; assert pfDeps.Model.Model.ID == execDeps.Model.Model.ID; assert !execCalled

tests.title: A tool that leaves PreflightExec nil reports an internal error under --preflight instead of silently running Exec
given: an App with Exec set and PreflightExec left nil
tests.when: the tool is invoked with --preflight
then: the envelope's error Category equals agentrun.CategoryInternal
the process exit code equals ExitFailed (1)
Exec is not invoked
tests.pseudocode: app := App{Exec: recordingExec, PreflightExec: nil}; code := app.Main(ctx, []string{"--preflight", input}, ...); assert code == toolio.ExitFailed; assert env.Error.Category == agentrun.CategoryInternal; assert !execCalled

tests.title: cmd/impl's --repair-model resolution is factored into one function called identically by Exec and PreflightExec
given: impl invoked with --repair-model=ADVANCED and a valid credential

tests.title: toolio.PreflightCheck exposes Check, OK and Detail with the documented JSON and trust tags

then: Check has json tag "check" and trust tag "fact"
OK has json tag "ok"
Detail has json tag "detail,omitempty" and trust tag "fact"
every field carries a non-empty description tag
tests.pseudocode: t := reflect.TypeOf(toolio.PreflightCheck{}); f,_ := t.FieldByName("Check"); assert f.Tag.Get("json") == "check"; assert f.Tag.Get("trust") == "fact"; assert f.Tag.Get("description") != ""

tests.title: toolio.Estimate exposes Phases, MaxTurnsPerPhase, MaxBudgetPerPhaseUSD and MaxTotalUSD with the documented JSON tags
tests.when: the struct fields of toolio.Estimate are inspected via reflection
then: Phases has json tag "phases"
MaxTurnsPerPhase has json tag "max_turns_per_phase"
MaxBudgetPerPhaseUSD has json tag "max_budget_per_phase_usd"
MaxTotalUSD has json tag "max_total_usd"
every field carries a non-empty description tag
tests.pseudocode: t := reflect.TypeOf(toolio.Estimate{}); for _, name := range []string{"Phases","MaxTurnsPerPhase","MaxBudgetPerPhaseUSD","MaxTotalUSD"} { f,_ := t.FieldByName(name); assert f.Tag.Get("description") != "" }

no model call is recorded on the runner's observer
tests.pseudocode: r, _ := agentrun.NewRunner(cfg); turns, budget := r.ResolvedBounds(); assert turns == 12; assert budget == 3.5; assert observer.CallCount == 0

tests.title: codefix.Result carries Preflight and Estimate fields immediately after DryRun

tests.title: An ordinary successful run's envelope carries no preflight or estimate key
given: a completed ordinary (non --preflight) successful run of any of the four tools
tests.when: the envelope's result object is marshalled to JSON
then: the JSON object carries no "preflight" key
the JSON object carries no "estimate" key
tests.pseudocode: env := runOrdinary(fixArgv); m := decodeJSON(env.Result); assert !hasKey(m, "preflight"); assert !hasKey(m, "estimate")

tests.title: An ordinary failing run's envelope carries no preflight or estimate key
given: an ordinary (non --preflight) run of impl against a dirty tree, which fails
tests.when: the envelope is marshalled to JSON
then: the JSON result object, if present, carries no "preflight" key
the JSON result object, if present, carries no "estimate" key
tests.pseudocode: env := runOrdinary(implArgvDirtyTree); m := decodeJSON(env.Result); assert !hasKey(m, "preflight"); assert !hasKey(m, "estimate")

tests.title: For any invocation that would fail before its first model call, adding --preflight does not change the failure
given: a corpus of failing pre-model scenarios across the four tools: dirty tree, unresolvable model, missing credential, invalid spec package, unreachable repository
tests.when: for any such scenario, the tool is invoked once without --preflight and once with --preflight added, on the same input and workspace state
then: stage, category, message and exit code are identical between the two invocations for every scenario in the corpus
tests.pseudocode: for scenario in corpus: a := runTool(scenario.argv); b := runTool(append(scenario.argv, "--preflight")); assert a.Error.Stage==b.Error.Stage; assert a.Error.Category==b.Error.Category; assert a.Error.Message==b.Error.Message; assert a.ExitCode==b.ExitCode

tests.title: impl --preflight on a dirty working tree fails with the exact same error object as impl without --preflight
given: a git repository with a valid spec package and an uncommitted change to a tracked file
tests.when: impl is invoked once with --preflight and once without, on the same repository state
then: the two JSON error objects (stage, category, message) compare byte-for-byte equal
both invocations exit with the usage exit code
tests.pseudocode: envA := runImpl(dirtyRepo, []string{specDir}); envB := runImpl(dirtyRepoCopy, []string{"--preflight", specDir}); assert bytes.Equal(marshal(envA.Error), marshal(envB.Error)); assert envA.ExitCode==toolio.ExitUsage; assert envB.ExitCode==toolio.ExitUsage

tests.title: A --preflight run that refuses partway through its checks reports no partial checklist of earlier passes
given: a workspace with a clean tree but a spec package whose test_commands audit fails, so codeimpl.preflight refuses after the clean-tree check has already passed
tests.when: impl --preflight is invoked
then: the envelope's result object carries no non-empty "preflight" array
only the fields the failing preflight function itself set before returning are present
tests.pseudocode: env := runImpl(dir, []string{"--preflight", specDir}); m := decodeJSON(env.Result); pf, ok := m["preflight"]; assert !ok || len(pf.([]any)) == 0

tests.title: A failing --preflight run creates no branch and makes no remote write beyond the pipeline's own pre-refusal actions
given: a clean git repository resolved to a base branch, with the forge client instrumented to record write calls, and a check that refuses after the base-branch resolution but before branch creation
tests.when: fix --preflight is invoked and its Preflight check refuses
then: no branch exists that did not exist before the invocation
the forge client records no write call
tests.pseudocode: branchesBefore := listBranches(dir); env := runFix(dir, []string{"--preflight", input}); branchesAfter := listBranches(dir); assert branchesBefore.Equal(branchesAfter); assert forge.WriteCalls == 0

tests.title: codefix.RunPreflight, on full success, runs the baseline and reports the fix checklist without creating a branch
given: a clean git repository with a detectable test command and no forge write required (no issue target, no --land=pr)
tests.when: codefix.RunPreflight(ctx, o) is called
then: the returned error is nil
result.Stage equals "preflight"
result.Baseline is populated
result.Preflight contains entries for git_repository, clean_tree, base_branch, verify_command and verify_baseline
no new branch exists in the repository
tests.pseudocode: res, err := codefix.RunPreflight(ctx, opts); assert err == nil; assert res.Stage == "preflight"; assert res.Baseline != nil; assert containsCheck(res.Preflight, "verify_baseline"); assert branchesBefore.Equal(listBranches(dir))

tests.title: codeimpl.RunPreflight, on full success, reports Tasks and the impl checklist without creating a new branch
given: a clean git repository holding a valid, active spec package with pending tasks and passing test_commands audit, whose target work branch does not yet exist
tests.when: codeimpl.RunPreflight(ctx, o) is called
then: the returned error is nil
result.Stage equals "preflight"
result.Tasks reflects the pending/skipped outcome of selectTasks
result.Preflight contains entries for git_repository, clean_tree, spec_resolved, branch, spec_valid, spec_status, test_commands, dependencies and verify_baseline
no branch named in result.Branch exists in the repository yet
tests.pseudocode: res, err := codeimpl.RunPreflight(ctx, opts); assert err == nil; assert res.Stage == "preflight"; assert len(res.Tasks) > 0; assert containsCheck(res.Preflight, "dependencies"); assert !branchExists(dir, res.Branch)

tests.title: specgen.RunPreflight, on full success, reports the spec checklist and writes no package to disk
given: a workspace with a resolvable runner and no existing split plan, invoked without --comment
tests.when: specgen.RunPreflight(ctx, o) is called
then: the returned error is nil
result.Preflight contains a schemas_valid entry
no new directory is written under the specs root

tests.title: issuetriage.RunPreflight, on full success, reports the resolved target and creates no issue
given: a report input with a resolvable target repository and a valid forge credential

then: the returned error is nil
result.Preflight contains a target_repository entry and (since not --dry-run) a forge_credential entry
the forge client records no issue-creation call
tests.pseudocode: res, err := issuetriage.RunPreflight(opts); assert err == nil; assert containsCheck(res.Preflight, "target_repository"); assert forge.IssueCreateCalls == 0

tests.title: fix's estimate reports exactly two phases with bounds from ResolvedBounds
given: a Runner whose ResolvedBounds() returns (10, 2.0)

then: result.Estimate.Phases equals 2
result.Estimate.MaxTurnsPerPhase equals 10
result.Estimate.MaxBudgetPerPhaseUSD equals 2.0
result.Estimate.MaxTotalUSD equals 4.0
tests.pseudocode: res, _ := codefix.RunPreflight(ctx, opts); assert res.Estimate.Phases == 2; assert res.Estimate.MaxTotalUSD == 2*res.Estimate.MaxBudgetPerPhaseUSD

tests.title: impl's estimate counts pending tasks plus a survey phase unless --no-survey was given
given: a spec package with 3 pending tasks
one invocation without --no-survey, one with --no-survey
tests.when: codeimpl.RunPreflight computes result.Estimate for each invocation
then: without --no-survey, result.Estimate.Phases equals 4
with --no-survey, result.Estimate.Phases equals 3
tests.pseudocode: resA, _ := codeimpl.RunPreflight(ctx, optsWithSurvey); assert resA.Estimate.Phases == 4; resB, _ := codeimpl.RunPreflight(ctx, optsNoSurvey); assert resB.Estimate.Phases == 3

tests.title: spec's estimate counts the PRD phase plus one per generation step, adds one for --architecture, and multiplies by a split plan's pending scope count when resuming
given: afspec.GenerationSteps has 3 entries
a fresh unsplit input, invoked with and without --architecture
a split plan on disk with 2 pending scopes
tests.when: specgen.RunPreflight computes result.Estimate for each case
then: a fresh input without --architecture reports Phases == 4 (1 PRD + 3 steps)
a fresh input with --architecture reports Phases == 5
resuming the 2-pending-scope split plan multiplies the one-package figure by 2
tests.pseudocode: resA, _ := specgen.RunPreflight(ctx, freshOpts); assert resA.Estimate.Phases == 1+len(afspec.GenerationSteps); resB, _ := specgen.RunPreflight(ctx, archOpts); assert resB.Estimate.Phases == resA.Estimate.Phases+1; resC, _ := specgen.RunPreflight(ctx, resumeOpts); assert resC.Estimate.Phases == resA.Estimate.Phases*2

tests.title: issue's estimate reports exactly one phase with bounds from ResolvedBounds
given: a Runner whose ResolvedBounds() returns (6, 1.5)

result.Estimate.MaxTotalUSD equals result.Estimate.MaxBudgetPerPhaseUSD
tests.pseudocode: res, _ := issuetriage.RunPreflight(opts); assert res.Estimate.Phases == 1; assert res.Estimate.MaxTotalUSD == res.Estimate.MaxBudgetPerPhaseUSD

tests.title: RunPreflight never calls Runner.Run, so the envelope carries no per-phase cost from the invocation

tests.title: A caller learns a fix run would refuse on a dirty tree, before any model call, through the real CLI shell
given: a real git repository whose working tree has an uncommitted change
a resolvable model and credential
tests.when: fix --preflight is invoked as a real process against the input
then: the process exits with the usage exit code
the emitted envelope's stage, category and message equal exactly what 'fix' (without --preflight) on the same tree state would emit
no branch is created
no model provider is called

tests.title: A caller confirms an impl run would proceed and reads its estimate, through the real CLI shell, before spending anything
given: a real, clean git workspace holding a valid, active spec package with pending tasks and a passing baseline
tests.when: impl --preflight is invoked as a real process against the spec package
then: the process exits 0
the emitted envelope's result carries a non-empty preflight array and a populated estimate
no new branch exists beyond any already-existing continuation branch checked out
no model provider is called

tests.title: spec --preflight resumes a real split plan and reports a phase estimate multiplied by the pending scope count
given: a real workspace holding a spec root with a recorded split plan naming 2 pending scopes
tests.when: spec --preflight is invoked as a real process against the same input that produced the split plan
then: the process exits 0
the emitted envelope's result.preflight contains schemas_valid and split_plan entries
result.estimate.phases equals one package's phase count multiplied by 2
no package directory is written to disk

tests.title: issue --preflight reports the resolved target repository through the real CLI shell without writing to the forge
given: a real git workspace whose origin remote resolves to a forge repository
a report given as input with no explicit --repo
tests.when: issue --preflight is invoked as a real process against the report
then: the process exits 0
the emitted envelope's result.preflight names target_repository and forge_credential
the forge client records no write call
no model provider is called
